papers.title: Constrained Acetabular Components Used in Revision Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Registry Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Australian Orthopaedic Association National Joint Replacement Registry, Adelaide, South Australia, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Peter L. Lewis
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Australian Orthopaedic Association National Joint Replacement Registry, Adelaide, South Australia, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向（髋关节植入物与股骨柄的生物力学分析）不相关，仅涉及髋臼杯翻修术的临床登记研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical registry analysis of constrained acetabular components in revision THA, with no biomechanical modeling, no quantification of stress shielding or micromotion, no FEA, and no patient-specific simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析限制性髋臼杯在翻修全髋关节置换术中的使用情况与临床结果。
summary_zh.method: 基于关节置换登记数据库进行回顾性分析。
summary_zh.result: 提供了限制性髋臼杯的使用趋势和并发症发生率。
summary_zh.validation: 未涉及生物力学验证，仅为临床数据分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the utilization and clinical outcomes of constrained acetabular components in revision total hip arthroplasty through registry data.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of a national joint replacement registry database.
summary_en.result: Reported trends in usage and complication rates for constrained acetabular components.
summary_en.validation: No biomechanical validation was performed; the study is purely based on clinical registry data.
